restrictions: Two distinct 64-byte messages, each a single BLAKE3 chunk with one root block (flags CHUNK_START|CHUNK_END|ROOT = 11, block length 64, counter 0), standard IV, unkeyed.
Deterministic straight-line construction from public constants: no search, no randomness, no precomputed advice; success probability 1.

Charged work: 236 primitive 256-bit-RAM word operations = 204 arithmetic/logic operations (reference normalization: add/sub with mask 2, xor 1, 32-bit rotation 4; identities on literal zero constants are not performed) plus 32 stores of the two 16-word messages; IV words are immediates. 236/222 = 1.063 target compressions = 2^0.088; claimed 2^0.1.
No full compression is evaluated by the attack; verification hashes are not part of the attack cost.
Both messages hash to the all-zero digest; they are included as a hash-collision-witness-v2 certificate checked by the organizer verifier.
